STRUCTURE

1-2 set the pattern. 3-5 are the three scenes, and each loses a recording a different way: it survives (Minneapolis), it is the only record there is (ICE), it is confiscated and destroyed (West Bank). 6 names the real problem as storage, not filming. 7-10 are the answer. 11 asks.

The product does not appear until slide 7, by which point the viewer has felt the need for it.

PHOTOS

All three are press photographs supplied by hand — check the rights before posting. They are run monochrome with contrast lifted and brightness cut, both to unify a 256px source with a 2400px one and to keep white text legible over them.

Slide 5 is anchored to the ICJ advisory opinion of 19 July 2024, UNSC 2334 and Fourth Geneva Convention Art. 49(6).
